# Tube furnace rework

## Intent
The writeup's lede, which is what done looks like to a reader:

> Toronto Hacker Fab's tube furnace works but was never characterised, and its mains wiring can short to the case. I modelled the build as it stands, in a 1-D simulator checked by hand and by 230 tests, so that the first logged run tests numbers instead of producing them. Flat zone 26 mm at ±5 °C, 48 s to the quartz limit if the relay fails closed, oxide rate set as much by room humidity as by the oxygen.

Ongoing: every number still to be measured is a prediction below.
